modelleertaal:
N = 1000
k = 0,1 '[kg/m] v = 12 '[m/s] m = 1 '[kg] alpha = 30 '[°]
vy = v*sin(alpha) '[m/s] vx = v*cos(alpha) '[m/s]
x = 0 '[m] y = 0 '[m]
g = 9,81 '[m/s^2] t = 0 '[s] dt = 0,01 '[s]
Fz = -m * g '[N]
'kogelbaan model met weerstand v = sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2)
Fw = -k * v^2 '[N] Fw_x = Fw * vx/v '[N] Fw_y = Fw * vy/v '[N]
Fres_x = Fw_x '[N] a_x = Fres_x / m '[m/s^2]
Fres_y = Fw_y + Fz '[N] a_y = Fres_y / m '[m/s^2]
vy = vy + a_y * dt y = y + vy * dt
vx = vx + a_x * dt x = x + vx * dt t = t + dt
als y < 0 dan stop eindals
